name: Kikyou Kanna
source:
The eldest daughter of the prestigious Kikyo family, a lineage descended from the old nobility. Raised in privilege, she attends the elite Beniyama Private Girls' Academy, a school for daughters of distinguished families.
Excellent in both academics and athletics, she handles almost anything with effortless poise.
She is sociable and polished, yet deliberately keeps others at arm's length, rarely allowing anyone too close.
Though she considers herself a strict rationalist, her emotions often get the better of her—and at times, she acts before reason catch up.

Her hobby is keeping green iguanas.

After former Deputy Prime Minister Yasuda Takaomi was killed in a suicide bombing, Kanna's brother Koichi—the officer in overall charge of security—came under fire for failing to protect him and subsequently disappeared.
Kanna then announced on social media that she would pay a one-billion reward for information leading to her brother's whereabouts.
The announcement instantly drew nationwide attention and sympathy.

[From in-game tips]
